lang: Hebrew (English summary p. 238 included in the PDF)
location_note: 'Jordanian Garden' outside the northern Old City wall, east of 'Solomon's Quarries' (Zedekiah's Cave); map ref. NIG 22206/63220, OIG 17206/13220.
notes: 1983 trench (23 x 20 m) at the Ottoman wall: extensive quarry with detached blocks, reused as a rock-cut moat (over 4 m deep) with a stone rampart, both attributed to the Seljuk barbican (1073-1098 CE). The Hebrew text adds that this quarrying cut into older cuttings 'almost certainly' of the Second Temple period. Moat and rampart are fortifications, not eligible. 'Zedekiah's Cave' is named as a landmark only; not coded.

features.subtype: older quarry cuttings penetrated by the later quarry
features.quote: חציבות קדומות יותר, שנעשו קרוב לוודאי בימי הבית השני

features.subtype: extensive quarry with detached blocks, reused as a rock-cut moat
